title: Quality ok, but need to figure out color schemes on shirts!
text: I got a really cool designed Dr. Strange shirt which was awesome BUT the color of the print was a dark green on a Clover green t shirt!  So in other words it does not stand out on the shirt but in fact melds into it and you can hardly see the design unless you are way up close, like 2 inches from it close .....and who wants that?  It made a pretty cool image completely fade into the t shirts color AND after I washed it the shirt shrank!  So hopefully next months will be better thought out and not on a shrinkable shirt too!  I shall see.
label: neutral
